differences.summary: Required-state absence is represented as GatewayUnavailable rather than a guessed UNKNOWN value; fail-closed semantics are unchanged.
V13 collector and trace freeze exactly three live reads per experimental request without adding a state cache.
Final chainId and AuthorizationState address are now uniquely frozen for explicit injection.
Dependency hashes advance from the preparation baseline to the final V13 evidence and governance freeze.
RC2 external dependency advances from active rerun to completed frozen evidence; consumed protocol fields do not change.
